newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: SLOVENIAN SHARES UP, SEEN OSCILLATING MEDIUM TERM.
newsitem.headline: SLOVENIAN SHARES UP, SEEN OSCILLATING MEDIUM TERM.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index rose 0.44 percent despite lower demand and traders forecast shares would fluctuate over the next two weeks.
"We cannot expect foreign demand to stay as strong as in the past two days throughout August so I expect the index to remain around the same level to the end of the month," one trader said.
* The SBI index rose 6.93 points to 1564.49.
* Health resort operator Terme Catez was the most actively traded share, rising 3.19 percent to 12.930 tolars on volume of 4,764 shares.

Analysts said Terme was expected to deliver good business results this year but noted that its growth potential was limited due to a lack of interest by foreign investors in the stock. -- Ljubljana Newsroom, 386-61-126-3644
